1.

O depth of mercy, Lord, with Thee, That blood on Golgotha hath cleansed even me! No sin and condemnation reach me more, Complete before God in Christ I stand.

C.

O, sing of His great grace, Sing of His great grace, Sing of His great grace, Sing of His grace!

2.

O depth of mercy, He hath love for me! From judgment’s terror ransomed I am free, And certain of my salvation I can praise His grace, which in the wilderness sought and found me.

3.

O depth of mercy, wonder of grace! For all He hath healing, ever knows the way; Each bleeding heart-sorrow He grants comfort, And tears are dried close by His breast.

4.

O Jesus, my Saviour, Lord and God, For Thee I will raise the sound of praise, And though through death’s vale I must go, I will yet rejoice in Thy great grace.
